Name: Female Characters Redone
Author: StirFryGingerBoy
Description:
I recommend that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]is installed in case the mod runs into any errors.

This mod changes the hair colors of all the females provided within the mod. Also changes colors of most of the females outfits.

Installation:
1. Download the mod above.
2. Open the download using winrar or other zip program.
3. Open the Stardew Valley mods folder. Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
4. Drag each female folder individually into the Stardew Valley Mods folder (Ex. Leah Redone) otherwise the mod will not work.
5. Play Stardew Valley
